members: @Bean public MapReactiveUserDetailsService userDetailsService(TelemetryProperties props, PasswordEncoder encoder) { List<UserDetails> users = new ArrayList<>(); for (TelemetryProperties.Credential c : props.devices()) { users.add(User.withUsername(c.id()).password(c.secretHash()).authorities("SCOPE_" + c.scope()).build()); } for (TelemetryProperties.Credential c : props.consumers()) { users.add(User.withUsername(c.id()).password(c.secretHash()).authorities("SCOPE_" + c.scope()).build()); } return new MapReactiveUserDetailsService(users); }
@Bean public TelemetryMetrics telemetryMetrics(MeterRegistry registry) { return new TelemetryMetrics(registry); }
@Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean public SensorMetricBoundary sensorMetricBoundary() { return new SensorMetricBoundary(); }

@Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean public BackfillReorderer backfillReorderer(TelemetryProperties props, TelemetryMetrics metrics) { return new BackfillReorderer(props.reorderWindow(), props.reorderBufferCapacity(), metrics); }
@Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean public Sha256RedactionAdapter sha256RedactionAdapter() { return new Sha256RedactionAdapter(); }

@Bean public AesGcmPayloadCipher aesGcmPayloadCipher(TelemetryProperties props, Environment env) { String dataKey = props.dataKey(); if (dataKey == null || dataKey.isBlank()) { if (!env.acceptsProfiles(Profiles.of("test"))) { throw new IllegalStateException("telemetry.data-key must be configured"); } byte[] key = new byte[32]; new SecureRandom().nextBytes(key); return new AesGcmPayloadCipher(key); } return new AesGcmPayloadCipher(Base64.getDecoder().decode(dataKey)); }

@Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean public R2dbcTelemetryRecordRepository r2dbcTelemetryRecordRepository(DatabaseClient client, AesGcmPayloadCipher cipher) { return new R2dbcTelemetryRecordRepository(client, cipher); }
@Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean public R2dbcAuditTrail r2dbcAuditTrail(DatabaseClient client) { return new R2dbcAuditTrail(client); }
@Bean public InProcessEventBus eventBus(TelemetryProperties props, TelemetryMetrics metrics) { return new InProcessEventBus(props.busCapacity(), metrics); }

@Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean public ValidatedEventConsumer validatedEventConsumer(TrustedPublisherPolicy policy, R2dbcAuditTrail audit, Sha256RedactionAdapter redaction, TelemetryMetrics metrics, TelemetryProperties props) { return new ValidatedEventConsumer(policy, audit, redaction, metrics, props.windowDuration(), props.windowMaxEvents()); }

@Bean public DeviceCredentialAuthenticationManager deviceCredentialAuthenticationManager(MapReactiveUserDetailsService users, PasswordEncoder encoder) { return new DeviceCredentialAuthenticationManager(users, encoder); }

@Bean public IngestPacketUseCase ingestPacketUseCase(R2dbcTelemetryRecordRepository repository, InProcessEventBus bus, R2dbcAuditTrail audit, SensorMetricBoundary boundary, BackfillReorderer reorderer, Sha256RedactionAdapter redaction, TelemetryMetrics metrics, Clock clock, TelemetryProperties props) { return new IngestPacketUseCase(repository, bus, audit, boundary, reorderer, redaction, metrics, clock, props.reorderWindow(), props.publisherId()); }

@Bean public BroadcastService broadcastService(ValidatedEventConsumer buffer, InProcessEventBus bus, TelemetryMetrics metrics, TelemetryProperties props) { return new BroadcastService(buffer, bus, metrics, props.broadcastCapacity()); }
@Bean public BroadcastLifecycle broadcastLifecycle(BroadcastService service) { return new BroadcastLifecycle(service); }
